## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/deepseek/chat/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['get the list of supported OpenAI params for a DeepSeek model including thinking and reasoning_effort', 'map OpenAI chat completion params to DeepSeek-compatible params handling thinking and reasoning_effort', 'transform message content lists to strings since DeepSeek does not support content in list format', 'get the DeepSeek API base URL and API key from arguments or environment variables', 'build the complete DeepSeek chat completions endpoint URL with proper path suffix']
```

Usage

```
{'get_supported_openai_params': 'get the list of supported OpenAI params for a DeepSeek model including thinking and reasoning_effort', 'map_openai_params': 'map OpenAI chat completion params to DeepSeek-compatible params handling thinking and reasoning_effort', 'transform_messages': 'transform message content lists to strings since DeepSeek does not support content in list format', 'get_provider_info': 'get the DeepSeek API base URL and API key from arguments or environment variables', 'get_complete_url': 'build the complete DeepSeek chat completions endpoint URL with proper path suffix'}
```
